stack: Unity, C# · ASP.NET Core and SQL Server

blocos.markdown:
At **Inbuilt**, I worked end to end on the product: from the app's interfaces and experience to augmented reality, computer vision, APIs, infrastructure and cloud data.

### Interfaces and UX

- Built the app's interfaces in Unity, focused on clarity for non-technical users
- Designed and refined user flows (UX) based on user feedback
- Responsive interfaces, adapted for **tablets** as well as smartphones

### Inbuilt X: augmented reality for homeowners

A section of the app for viewing a home's installations in augmented reality, designed for homeowners and also used during construction. I was actively involved in its development, maintenance and improvements, in the app and in the backend.

- Automatic detection of when the experience is available, based on the user's location
- Augmented reality interactions to view the home's architecture in the room itself, such as **electrical**, **plumbing**, **gas** and **sewage** installations
- Layers that can be turned on and off, to see one installation at a time
- Built in Unity with C#, **ARCore**/**ARKit**

### Computer vision

- Integrated **OpenCV** into the app to identify **starting points** from the camera
- Used the detection to place the installations in augmented reality more accurately

### Inbuilt GO: the building's façade at real size
A section of the app that shows the **development's façade at real size**, on the actual site, in augmented reality. I took part in the initial implementation and was actively involved in maintaining and improving the service, in the app and in the backend.

- Geolocation-based positioning with the **ARCore Extensions** libraries
- Automatic detection of when the experience is available, based on the user's location

### Inbuilt GO: development miniatures on the web

Web experiences that show the façade in a 3D viewer and also in augmented reality as a **digital scale model**. I built the API that creates and manages the pages for these experiences on **Inbuilt**'s corporate website

- 3D miniatures of the developments on the web with `model-viewer`

blocos.legenda: Web miniatures of the development's façade

blocos.markdown:
### Cloud and data

- **Migrated** the APIs and databases from AWS to **Google Cloud**
- Usage tracking recorded in SQL, with **Dataflow** scripts moving the data to **BigQuery**
- **Looker** dashboards with up-to-date metrics made available to clients

### Stack

- **App and augmented reality:** Unity with C#, ARCore and ARKit
- **Computer vision:** OpenCV integrated into Unity
- **API:** C# with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework, SQL Server database
- **Cloud and data:** Google Cloud, Dataflow, BigQuery and Looker
- **Web:** HTML, JavaScript and CSS; `model-viewer` for the 3D miniatures
